description: This file is a shell script that acts as a library for CVS and Git repository testing, including setup, checkout, and comparison functions for different branches in CVS and Git repositories.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository by copying a predefined CVSROOT for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a CVS module branch or main branch for testing.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a branch in a Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares a specific file between CVS and Git checked out branches.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares entire directory trees between CVS and Git branches to ensure they are identical.
